data.heading: Ready to order?
Two bankers walk into a coffee shop
data.body_markdown: Tom and Cat spent years in mortgage banking before deciding the world needed one more genuinely good neighborhood coffee shop more than it needed two more bankers. Trouble Brewing is the result — a warm, art-filled room in the heart of Haddon Heights where the coffee is serious and the vibe is not.

data.heading: Why La Colombe
data.body_markdown: We partnered with **La Colombe** because great coffee shouldn't be complicated — it should be consistent, ethical, and delicious. That partnership is the foundation we build every drink on.

data.heading: Why local matters
data.body_markdown: Independent shops are the connective tissue of a town. We buy local where we can, host our neighbors, and try to send everyone back out the door a little more caffeinated and a little more cared-for.

data.body: Showers, meetings, small parties — our space is yours. Tell us what you're planning.
data.heading: Want to host something?
Parking
data.body_markdown: Street parking is available out front, plus a **lot behind the coffee house**. Enter from White Horse Pike or Atlantic Ave.

data.heading: Get in touch
data.body_markdown: Questions, ideas, or planning something? Use the form below for general questions, or the catering form for events. We read every message.

data.heading: Loyalty
data.body_markdown: Regulars are the heart of this place. Ask a Troublemaker about our loyalty perks next time you're in. *(Full program details coming soon.)*

data.heading: Skip the line

data.body_a: We pull serious espresso, press paninis to order, and turn out warm brioche breakfast sandwiches, fresh-baked scones, and specialty drinks worth the trip — plus gluten-free and vegan options.
data.body_b: Come for an event, meet the Troublemakers behind the counter, or just sink into the green-walled, art-covered room our regulars call a second home. That's the good kind of Trouble.

testimonials.author: Hazel Stjernelys
testimonials.quote:
While browsing for coffee shops in the area, this one caught my eye. It did not disappoint! This shop is cozy, clearly loved by locals, and has plenty of seating without feeling overcrowded. Chosen decor includes foxes and mushrooms and adds the right touch of whimsy 🍄
I'm not out this way often but I'll definitely stop again the next time I am!

testimonials.author: Cory Mathews
testimonials.quote: Good coffee for a good price. Blueberry scone was very good massive Blueberrys barista Tyler was friendly and fast would visit again when on a trip from California

testimonials.author: Leticia Vega
testimonials.quote: My son and I stopped in to have a hot chia and cold latte with breakfast sandwiches and pastries. Great service, drinks and food great. Beautiful town. Been there before. Bonus--it's dog friendly 🦮. Definitely will be back.

testimonials.author: Heather Roth
testimonials.quote: Definitely one of my favorite coffee shops that I have come across. I love that they collaborate with other local businesses. I’m a big fan of their Milky Way iced coffee, and their breakfast sandwiches are delicious. I love hanging out inside or outside. Their staff are fantastic. I love chatting with them every time I go in.
